remarks: Sophisticated and timeless, this beautifully crafted colonial offers refined living in a private Greenwich setting. Designed with both elegance and functionality in mind, the home features 5 bedrooms, 4.1 baths, sun-filled interiors, and graciously scaled rooms ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The heart of the home is the chef's kitchen, seamlessly flowing into the main living spaces. Rich hardwood floors, two fireplaces, and thoughtful architectural details create a warm yet elevated atmosphere throughout. A fully finished lower level provides flexible space for a media room, gym, or playroom. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a screened porch, stone patio and a fenced backyard, offering privacy and tranquility. A rare opportunity to enjoy polished, move-in-ready living just minutes from downtown Greenwich.
